title: D, one-width cuts
one: D with both cuts one width, the version before the bigger play.
idea: D with the slot and the diagonal one width, 1/7 of the bookmark's, so the two cuts look made by one blade; its play is smaller than D's.
built: Slot and diagonal both 6.21 dp (before the 90%). Play 17.94 × 15.54 dp, its tip 3.11 dp short of the slot; D's bigger play is 8% taller, its tip 1.86 dp short.
small: 48 px: the diagonal dropped 5 px (D: 4), 4.34 px square to itself; the play 11 px tall, its tip 2.38 px short of the slot. 32 px: dropped 4 px (D: 3); the play 8 px tall, its tip 2 px short of the slot. 16 px, the glyph and the extension's buttons are D's.
risks: The play is smaller against the two bars, which the reviewer with no context read as pause first.
